name: decode_interface_builder
description: Decode compiled storyboard and nib archives inside the active Apple app bundle, including keyed property lists and NIBArchive object tables, into a bounded object, hierarchy, and connection graph. This is static archive parsing; unrecognized archive classes and unresolved code handlers remain explicit unknowns. A full app graph is often several megabytes; detail summary retains it and returns documents with node, edge and coverage counts, then page rows, optionally one document's, with inspect_analysis_view kind interface-builder.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete decoded graph Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for interface-builder pages.
